name: 91724 · Covina, CA
findings: ZIP 91724 (Covina) has 126 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91724 (Covina) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91724 (Covina) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).
